verdict.rationale: Postman ships an official, documented Postman CLI. It runs collections with reporters, starts mock servers, lints specs, runs governance and security checks, manages webhooks and generates SDKs, and it explicitly supports giving coding agents CLI context for API discovery and code generation. It also integrates with CI/CD alongside the Postman API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in AI-native or agent workflows.
